The earlier-reply note (short.py:98-101) is prompt text only and decide() ships the model's own reply, so it is permitted under the 2026-10-29 I4 reused-draft clarification. Longer routed hints (qtype.py:105, thint.py:275), lane routing (lane.py:417-422) and a per-turn completion cap (action.py:83-85) are routed guidance or resource settings. No I1-I8 or S1-S3 ground.
